[0] Update, Eastern Time 5:36 PM: Apple has also released the fifth public betas of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a) and tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a).

[1] Developers can now install the fifth betas of several upcoming system updates, including iPadOS 26.6. Here are the details.

[2] iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and HomePod 26.6 beta 5 are now available

[3] As the beta cycle for Apple's 26.6 software updates nears its end, the company is now pushing out the fifth betas of iPadOS 26.6 (23G5065a), watchOS 26.6 (23U5062b), tvOS 26.6 (23L5766a), visionOS 26.6 (23O5765a), and HomePod 26.6 (23L5766a).

[4] These updates are rolling out alongside the fifth betas of iOS 26.6 and macOS 26.6, and like those updates, they primarily include bug fixes—some of which Apple decided to release early in response to growing threats from AI-driven security exploits.

[5] This is likely the final round of betas before the RC version is released. As the official versions of the 26.6 updates approach, most of the attention from Apple and the developer community is shifting to iOS 27 and its accompanying updates, expected to debut publicly this fall. Apple is also expected to roll out the first public betas soon.

[6] Regardless, developers can now install the fifth beta of iPadOS 26.6 and its counterparts, with public versions also expected in the near future.
